verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that the Agent APIs let you track Custom Agent usage and manage their credit limits. That shows limits exist and can be monitored or set, but nothing explains what happens when a limit is exceeded. Missing for 10: documented behavior on exceeding limits (overage charges, throttling/HTTP 429 rate-limit handling, or hard stops), REST API rate-limit documentation, automation run limits per plan, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
